title: A running mean
summary: Fill in the blanks: a word, a number and a line of code.
text: After the values 2, 4 and 9 the mean is [[mean]]. Adding one more value $x$ to $n$ values with mean $m$ gives the new mean $m + (x - m) / k$, where $k$ is [[denominator]]. So a stream needs only the count and the [[state]] so far.
